parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the ID.

element_fields.description_en:
The configuration content. You can pass in one of the following values:

- The configuration content text. For the format, see [Driver and device information configurations](~~120906~~).
- The Object Storage Service (OSS) address where the configuration file is stored.
element_fields.description_zh:

- 配置内容文本。格式请参见[驱动与设备信息配置](~~120906~~)内容。
- 存储配置文件的阿里云对象存储（OSS）地址。
